implementationBaseline: Native flow stage following 8d93cb3 image integration
scope: Generic native flow geometry on ordinary accepted scene nodes; no physical heat/fluid/electrical simulation.
redaction: No credentials, endpoint hostnames, raw model prompts, full diagnostic traces, or full Undo affected-node lists. Local receipts and accepted documents are referenced by checksum.

contract.attachmentCoordinates: Source/target structural node local; route points and width annotation local.
contract.bindingResolution: inverse(annotationWorld) * endpointWorld * localPoint from complete candidate accepted hierarchy.
contract.coincidentEndpoints: Retain node identity and suppress degenerate visuals.
contract.lifecycle: Existing transactional scene operations and Undo; dependent annotations must be removed with a deleted structural endpoint.

legacyHashVectors.boundary: File adds one flow request and two flow geometry vectors. Every prior entry remains exactly equal; previous recipe/request hashes are unchanged.

liveAcceptance.reducer: Production SpatialCore.SceneState and SceneWireDecoder via persistent SceneLab reducer process.
liveAcceptance.inputBoundary: Synthetic phone snapshots from the procedural 179-node rack and inline three-node lamp. Not imported CAD, native measured bounds, or camera observations.
liveAcceptance.sceneSHA256Meaning: Harness digest of canonicalized scene JSON; sceneFileSHA256 separately hashes exact exported file bytes.

oneFlowFixture.subject: synthetic non-rack two-chamber fixture
oneFlowFixture.observed: Curved cyan flow line and Flow 1 label between structural chambers.
oneFlowFixture.source: Computer-control screenshot observation; no saved screenshot file claimed.
oneFlowFixture.backendBoundary: Existing saved endpoint unavailable; connection error visible, while renderer and sampler continued independently. Not live conversation acceptance.

thirtyTwoFlowStressFixture.observed: All colored flow paths and moving markers visible; many labels overlap substantially.
thirtyTwoFlowStressFixture.source: Computer-control screenshot observation; no saved screenshot file claimed.

simulatorMetrics.boundary: Explicit synthetic Debug fixture. CPU marker-loop wall time and SceneEvents.Update cadence; no GPU-time, thermal-soak, pointing, or visual-fidelity claim.
simulatorMetrics.hostBoundary: Both iPhone and iPad simulators were running; this is not an isolated hardware or GPU measurement. Saved development configuration was supplied silently so the fixture view did not show the earlier connection error.

liveImportedRackSimulator.scene: Actual app imported rack, initially 20 nodes

visualObservation.followup: A request to lift the bound server by 1 m advanced revision 2 with 21 nodes; computer control observed the path and markers move with the server.
visualObservation.labelReadability: White Airflow label was unreadable over the silver chassis.
visualObservation.source: Computer-control screenshot observation; no saved screenshot file claimed.
visualObservation.measurementBoundary: Logs verify accepted revisions, node counts, and native timing. Exact translation distances describe the requested edit; rendered coordinates were not independently measured.

preLabelReversalScreenshot.observed: Reversed cyan arrowhead points toward the server front; white marker spheres visible; tiny white Airflow label has poor contrast against silver geometry.

labelPolish.reason: Unreadable white text against the imported silver chassis.
labelPolish.change: Text scale increased to 0.035 with a shared dark unit-plane backing scaled to text bounds, included in retained and expanded resource metrics.
labelPolish.observed: The Airflow label is clearly readable as larger white text on a dark backing above the silver chassis; cyan curve and white markers remain visible.
labelPolish.measurementBoundary: One inspected iPad simulator view; not a universal readability guarantee or physical AR result.

simulatorMetricsBeforeLabelPolish.boundary: Explicit synthetic Debug fixture. CPU marker-loop wall time and SceneEvents.Update cadence; no GPU-time, thermal-soak, pointing, or visual-fidelity claim.

finalOrdinaryLaunches.boundary: Ordinary process launch only; no claim about visible AR, anchoring, backend readiness, or GPU performance.

readinessEvidence.boundary: Ready event preceded the separate Debug benchmark run; process launch and later benchmark have distinct run IDs.

finalOrdinaryLaunches.boundary: Ordinary process launch only; no claim about visible AR, anchoring, backend readiness, or GPU performance.

physicalFinalMetrics.failure: Required 30-sample, 30-second run did not complete; only four samples through 4.100 seconds were retained.
physicalFinalMetrics.claimBoundary: This failed attempt provides no qualified physical timing result. Its four partial samples remain excluded from comparisons; the separately recorded later successful retry supplies CPU/callback/resource evidence only.

audioCrash.diagnosis: Audio input callback inherited actor isolation and trapped on the audio callback queue. This interrupted the zero-flow baseline; it is not evidence of a flow marker-loop crash.
audioCrash.fixVerification: Not assessed by these flow receipts; the successful retry predates the subsequent audio callback fix.

physicalMetricsSuccessfulRetry.boundary: Explicit synthetic Debug fixture. CPU marker-loop wall time and SceneEvents.Update cadence; no GPU-time, thermal-soak, pointing, or visual-fidelity claim.
physicalMetricsSuccessfulRetry.timingStatisticBoundary: Final values are the last rolling 300 callbacks per run, not percentiles over all thirty one-second samples.
physicalMetricsSuccessfulRetry.sourceSelection: Each cumulative diagnostic file is filtered by the receipt correlationID; earlier process runs are excluded.
physicalMetricsSuccessfulRetry.buildBoundary: Dated signed build from the flow stage before the subsequent audio callback fix. This receipt does not validate later audio changes or embed an executable checksum.

physicalAttemptChronology.basis: Embedded receipt startedAt, matching acceptance events, and system crash captureTime; not directory names or file modification times.
physicalAttemptChronology.conclusion: The successful physical retry followed the four-sample audio-crashed baseline and preceded the subsequent audio callback fix.

rendererBoundary.reduceMotion: Disable markers; preserve static shaft, arrowhead and label. Native renderer toggle tested and wired to SwiftUI environment; live operating-system preference change not exercised.
rendererBoundary.cache: Prepared candidate resources are installed and pruned atomically; ordinary frame updates change marker transforms only.
rendererBoundary.label: Cached larger white native text with BillboardComponent and shared dark backing near path midpoint; final rack view has verified contrast, while high-density overlap remains a separate concern.

metricsContract.fixture: Synthetic illustrative non-rack transfer manifold, production scene/controller/renderer, no model request.
metricsContract.metricKind: marker-loop CPU wall time and SceneEvents.Update callback cadence, not GPU time
metricsContract.resourceMeaning: Retained unique meshes/vertices/triangles; admission limits separately count expanded instances.
metricsContract.markerCountMeaning: Allocated marker entities, including disabled markers.
metricsContract.visibleFlowCountMeaning: Ancestor-enabled flow nodes, including degenerate nodes; no frustum or occlusion measurement.
metricsContract.cancellation: Inactive/interrupted/replaced view, changed scene, or missing original fixture prevents completed acceptance.

reproduction.outputBoundary: Outputs beneath ignored .local/. Metrics require a new output directory, installed Debug app, and active available target.

limitations: Live reducer acceptance establishes scene data/receipts and preserved bindings, not rendered path movement.
Host Undo restores the pre-deletion hidden flow, not its earlier visible state.

Physical iPhone metrics establish instrumented marker-loop CPU wall time, callback cadence, and retained resource counts for the dated pre-audio-fix build. No physical visual, AR anchoring, GPU-time, thermal-soak, or pointing claim.

The 22:48 physical baseline retained four samples over 4.100 seconds before an audio callback actor-isolation trap and is unqualified. The separate 22:50–22:52 retry passed all four counts; it does not verify later audio fixes.
Recorded iPad physical metric and ordinary launches were locked; no qualified iPad physical metrics are included.

verification.handshakeRace: Early session.accepted before hello send completion is supported by a narrow guard fix; six bridge tests pass.
